text:
anna_sales: Starting Aurora Systems POC thread. They need hosted API keys for a demo tomorrow, plus pricing and lead time for Dedicated + a private VPC path if it goes well. POC length 30 days. Request: billing project with $6k target cap and $1.5k in trial credits. Who can confirm next steps?

ryan_solutions: Hosted keys + trial credits are fine to get them started. Dedicated + VPC require capacity intake and security review. For billing project I'll need billing contact email and whether they want invoices to go to their AP team.

priya_eng: For Dedicated ETA depends on region/model. asia-southeast1 usually 3-4 weeks if inventory available. For an immediate demo, we can bump hosted quotas and provide ephemeral keys, but that won't provide a committed throughput SLA.

emma_finops: Caveat on "spend cap": we provide token quotas and alerts for hosted projects, not an automated hard stop. Ops can manually disable keys if the customer requires a hard cutoff. We can apply $1.5k credit to the billing project. I need billing email and optional PO to create the project.

anna_sales: Aurora prefers ephemeral keys (6h TTL) and a CI key for embeddings only. Region preference: asia-southeast1. Can we do 6h TTLs?

ryan_solutions: Yes, 6h TTL supported. I'll prepare a short script and guidance for rotating keys in CI. Example (internal):
```
redwoodctl keys create --project aurora-poc --ttl 6h --scopes generation,embeddings --rate 60r/s
```
It returns a one-time token. Recommend CI key scoped to embeddings only.

priya_eng: If you want Dedicated, open capacity request with expected qps and model family. I'll tag eng-runtime. For now, we can set project token quota to approximate $6k and wire alerts.

sec_audit: For VPC/private we need customer CIDR block, allowed egress IPs, and an ops contact to coordinate firewall rules. Also require signed DPA and SOC2 evidence if they request on-prem. Security review usually 3-7 business days after docs submitted.

ops_oncall: If a strict off-switch is required, ops can disable the project keys manually. We can automate a runbook but it needs an owner and a ticket.

ryan_solutions: Proposed minimal path to unblock the demo tomorrow:
- create billing project `aurora-poc` and apply $1.5k credit
- mint ephemeral 6h keys for dev/test + CI embedding key
- set token quota approximating $6k for 30 days
- configure alerts to aurora-eng@ and CS
- open capacity + security intake for Dedicated/VPC in parallel if needed

emma_finops: I'll provision the billing project once I get billing contact and PO. Draft onboarding note to customer: "This POC project has trial credits applied and a token quota to help control spend. Quota-triggered alerts will be sent to your engineering contact and Redwood CS. If you require an absolute stop, contact support@redwood.com and ops can disable project keys."

anna_sales: Sending billing contact (billing@aurorasys.com) and PO via DM now. Please queue the project create and mint ephemeral keys. Also include a brief note in the onboarding email clarifying soft cap behavior.

deploy-bot: Job queued: create-billing-project/aurora-poc requested by emma_finops ETA 1m.

emma_finops: Billing project created: aurora-poc. Project ID rwd-au-00987. Applied $1.5k credit. Please confirm keys + quotas.

ryan_solutions: Minted ephemeral key (masked): sk_demo_****pqrs TTL 6h. Token quota set to $6k equivalent for 30-day window. Alerts configured to aurora-eng@ and cs@redwood.com.

priya_eng: Opened capacity request REQ-5237 for asia-southeast1 Dedicated pool (model family: opt-13b quantized). ETA estimate 3-4 weeks.

sec_audit: Security intake ticket SEC-1310 created; questionnaire sent to anna_sales.

ops_oncall: If you want the automated kill-runbook, open a task in #eng-oncall with project id and owner. We can script it within 48h once an owner is assigned.

anna_sales: Thanks team 44d. I'll update once DPA signed and when Aurora confirms they want Dedicated. Marking this thread resolved from sales side.
